changes: Vendor Quote Upload: for any vendor-trade item on Repair Consult (buyer or seller side), the agent can now toggle "Already have a vendor quote?", type in the raw amount the vendor already texted/quoted, optionally attach a photo of that quote, and instantly see the computed client price (vendor amount + admin-configurable markup %, default 20%) — no waiting on a formal dispatch round-trip. Real-world case: Ross Woods / 0 Charles Avenue Jacksonville land-clearing quote from vendor Alex.
New vendor_quote_settings table + GET /api/vendor-quote-settings + PATCH /api/admin/vendor-quote-settings (markupPct, default 0.20).

repair_consult_items gained vendor_quote_amount + markup_pct_applied columns; repair_consults gained vendor_quoted_subtotal column. POST /api/repair-consult/:id/items now computes and persists these for any vendor item where the agent supplied vendorQuoteAmount, and returns vendorQuotedSubtotal in the response.

Client: RepairConsultSheet's vendor item cards render the toggle, $ input, live client-price preview, and photo attach (reuses the existing /api/repair-consult/:id/photo pipeline with kind: 'vendor_quote'). Sticky checklist total bar and Review step summary card each gained a 'Vendor-Coordinated' line plus a Grand Total line when both in-house and vendor-quoted amounts are present. Resume/load-existing-consult path restores hasVendorQuote/vendorQuoteAmount per item.

Vendor-facing scope emails (vendorScopeHtml, feeding all 3 vendor-email call sites) and both PDF exports (compact quote + internal work order) now show the priced amount inline for any vendor item that has a vendor quote on file, plus a Vendor-Coordinated Subtotal line.
Deliberately unchanged: public client-facing accept-page endpoint (GET /api/repair-quote/:token) still returns vendor items as name-only, no price shown to the client on that page.
Deliberately out of scope: InspectionsPlusSheet.tsx untouched — feature is repair-trades-only per explicit request wording.

endpoints.__note: Confirms the settings row was seeded and the GET endpoint is registered and returns the expected shape.

__bundleNotes: 'Already have a vendor quote' and 'Vendor-Coordinated' are literal UI copy strings that survive minification unchanged. 'vendor_quote' appears in the kind literal passed to the photo upload endpoint.

mathChecks.name: vendor-quote-settings markupPct is a valid fraction between 0 and 1
